seoTitle: Product Not Showing on Shopify? Here's the Fix
metaDescription: Learn the common reasons a Shopify product doesn't appear on your online store or collections, and how to fix visibility issues quickly.
intro: It's a common but fixable problem when a product added correctly in the Shopify admin panel doesn't actually show up on the storefront or in collections. This guide covers the most common causes across dropshipping, print-on-demand, and regular stores, and how to resolve each one.

steps.heading: Check the product's sales channel status
steps.body: Confirm the product is actually published to your Online Store sales channel, since a product can exist in the admin without being assigned to be visible on the storefront.

steps.heading: Verify the product is set to active
steps.body: Products set to draft or archived status won't appear on the storefront even if all other details are filled in correctly.

steps.heading: Check collection assignment and filters
steps.body: If a product doesn't show in a specific collection, confirm it meets that collection's automatic filter rules or has been manually added.

steps.heading: Look for inventory-related visibility issues
steps.body: Some theme or app settings hide out-of-stock products automatically, so check inventory settings if a product with zero stock isn't appearing.

steps.heading: Rule out theme-level filtering
steps.body: Certain themes apply their own visibility filters, so check theme customization settings if the product still doesn't appear after the above checks.

faq.question: Why is my product visible in the admin but not on my storefront?
faq.answer: This usually means the product hasn't been published to the Online Store sales channel, or its status is set to draft rather than active.

faq.question: Can low or zero inventory hide a product?
faq.answer: Yes, some theme and app settings automatically hide out-of-stock products from the storefront, so check those settings if inventory is at zero.

faq.question: Does this issue affect dropshipping and print-on-demand stores too?
faq.answer: Yes, the same visibility settings — sales channel, status, and collection rules — apply regardless of your store's fulfillment model.

faq.question: How do I fix a product missing from a specific collection?
faq.answer: Check whether the collection uses automatic filter conditions the product doesn't meet, or manually add the product if the collection is set to manual selection.
